skill.content:
---
name: paginate
description: Continue reading pages when the explicit goal requires all records.
---

If the task requests all records and the latest page has a continuation cursor,
read the next page with that cursor. Stop when the tool reports the final page.

tasks.prompt:
sase.goal=all
Read all records and return their IDs. Use the sase_page tool, starting at page 1. Return a single JSON object {"ids":[...]} containing each requested record ID exactly once in any order.

sase.goal=first
Read only the first page and return its record IDs. Use the sase_page tool, starting at page 1. Return a single JSON object {"ids":[...]} containing each requested record ID exactly once in any order.
